name: The Jantar Mantar, Jaipur
description: In the heart of Jaipur, near the City Palace, Jantar Mantar is an open-air observatory of about 20 giant stone and masonry instruments, completed in 1734 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II. Without any telescopes, visitors can still see how they track the sun, stars and planets by shadow and sight. Its towering sundial is the largest of its kind in the world.
